slides.big: The first video wasn't the problem.
When it ends, YouTube already has suggestions for the next one.
slides.body: Suggested by the app. **Not by you.**

slides.big:
Then the next.
Then the next.
In one US study of children aged 3 to 5, extra videos that played by themselves after their playlist ended meant longer viewing, and more parents having to step in.
slides.note: Hiniker and colleagues, 2018. 24 families, three weeks. One small study.

slides.kicker: So we built it the other way round

slides.body: About five videos, built around your choices. No Shorts.
